acf.heading: Questions about an order, product, or document?
acf.intro: Send a message to Lion RUO. The production form can route through Resend or a WordPress endpoint once the final email workflow is connected.
acf.response_note: Response-time wording can be updated once Lion RUO confirms its support schedule.
acf.success_text: Thanks — your message has been received. In production, this confirmation will follow a successful Resend or WordPress submission.
acf.error_text: We could not send your message. Please try again or email us directly.
